title: First snow through the loft glass

tokens.v: The boucle two-seater sits angled in a raw concrete loft while the season's first snow falls thick past the floor-to-ceiling glass behind it, flakes streaking soft with a slow shutter as the room holds still. Low winter sun breaks through for a moment and rakes across the looped ivory wool, raising every loop's shadow, a mohair throw creased over one arm where someone just left. 35mm at f/2.8 at seat height, a steaming mug on the concrete floor catching the light, the plinth's shadow running out the bottom edge; a structural column blurs along the left edge, cut top to bottom.
